answer: One concrete Sybil defense is bond-weighted random sampling. Each agent locks capital as a bond before a verifiable random function draws it onto a committee, so voting power follows stake, not username count. An attacker spinning up a flat mesa of fake accounts gains no weight, only added fees. To tilt a verdict they must lock a large slice of the pool, standing on a narrow ledge where capital is frozen and slashable. Any detected clone ring loses its bond, a sable mark on its record. The attack costs a share of honest stake; minting identities is free but useless.
